title: Aggrega Catalog (SchemaLibrary)
description: A reusable collection of JSON Schema 2020-12 definitions that catalog content (Components, Features, etc.) can $ref into via the bare-name identity reference <Library>#/schemas/<name> (the version is supplied by the per-Release lockfile; no registry host appears in the reference). Tier 3 — opt-in for catalogs that need cross-Component schema reuse.

name.description: PascalCase identifier for the library. It is the <Library> name in the bare-name identity reference <Library>#/schemas/<name>; the version is supplied by the per-Release lockfile and no registry host enters the reference or any derived identifier.

version.description: Strict Semantic Versioning of the library (e.g., 1.0.0). The per-Release lockfile pins one version per library.

description.description: A concise summary of what the library covers.

labels.description: Author-declared labels. The compiler does not interpret label values (per the dumb-compiler invariant); labels are metadata for discovery + hub UI surfacing.

annotations.description: Author-declared annotations. Same opaque-metadata posture as labels.

propertyNames.description: PascalCase identifier — `^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`. Entry keys appear in bare-name identity references (`<Library>#/schemas/<name>`); the envelope-level constraint prevents non-PascalCase keys from propagating through the catalog ecosystem.

additionalProperties.description: A single schema entry. Authored in compact form, JSON Schema 2020-12 YAML, or mixed (per-node dispatch via the compact-form compiler's content-shape detection). Entries may also use $instantiate: to reference a template declared under spec.templates with $args: bindings — substitution is literal-scalar-only.

schemas.description: Named map of reusable schema definitions. Each entry's content is validated by the compact-form compiler at parse time; the envelope-level validation only checks the structural wrapping.

propertyNames.description: PascalCase identifier — `^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`. Same envelope-level discipline as schema entry keys; template names are referenced via $instantiate: at instantiation time.

additionalProperties.description: A single parameter declaration. Carries type + optional default + optional constraint. Used by $instantiate: bindings; literal-scalar-substitution semantic only — no Go templating, no conditionals, no loops.

$params.description: Named map of template parameters. Each parameter's $args: binding is substituted as a literal scalar into the template body at instantiation.

additionalProperties.description: A single template entry. Carries $params: declarations plus a body that references $params: placeholders by literal scalar substitution. Referenced from schema entries via $instantiate: + $args:.

templates.description: Optional named map of parameterized helpers. Schema entries reference templates by name via $instantiate:; literal scalar substitution only — no embedded Go templates, no conditionals, no loops. The library substitution layer is intentionally narrower than full template evaluation so authoring stays in the schema language rather than introducing a separate templating surface.

spec.description: The SchemaLibrary's content. spec.schemas is required and must declare at least one entry; spec.templates is optional and only present when the library uses parameterized helpers.
